title: 실제로 읽기: 맛있어요, 읽다, 앉다
objective: Say final consonants that move on (음악 [으막]) and the double finals ㄺ and ㄵ (읽다 [익따], 앉아요 [안자요]).
summary: Learn why 맛있어요, 읽다 and 앉다 sound different from how they are written.

task.title: Say the real sound
task.line: Read each word out loud, then choose or write how it really sounds in [ ].

letters.sound: The final consonant moves to the next syllable: 음악 [으막].
Before a consonant, say only ㄱ: 읽다 [익따] (but in verbs before ㄱ, say ㄹ: 읽고 [일꼬]). The next ㄷ, ㄱ, ㅈ, ㅅ, ㅂ becomes tense: 읽지 [익찌]. Before ㅇ, ㄹ stays and ㄱ moves: 읽어요 [일거요].
letters.as: Like 'walk': the l is written but not said.

letters.sound: Before a consonant, say only ㄴ: 앉다 [안따]. In verbs, the next ㄷ, ㄱ, ㅈ becomes tense: 앉고 [안꼬], 앉지 [안찌]. Before ㅇ, ㄴ stays and ㅈ moves: 앉아요 [안자요].
letters.as: Like 'sign': the g is written but not said.

exercises: Choose the real sound: ① 집에 [지베 / 집에] ② 옷을 [옷을 / 오슬] ③ 밥이 [바비 / 밥이]
Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 읽으세요 ② 앉았어요 ③ 멋있어요
No vowel follows the double final. Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 닭 ② 읽지 ③ 앉고
Read the sentence aloud and write the real sound in [ ]: ① 여기에 앉지 마세요. ② 이 책 읽었어요?
answers: ① [여기에 안찌 마세요] ② [이 책 일거써요]
